name: pillars-section
title: Pillars section
description: Three big ideas set as tall columns divided by hairlines: a numeral, a heading, a paragraph and a short list under each.
docs: Pass title (and optionally eyebrow and description) and pillars, two to four of them: each has a title and a description, and optionally a marker, points (a short list), href and linkLabel. The marker is a large numeral or a 36px icon; without one the pillar's number is used. It is decoration, and an ordered list carries the sequence. The columns are rows of one grid (subgrid), so the headings, paragraphs, lists and links line up across them whatever their length, and a pillar without a list or a link keeps its row. Vertical hairlines divide the columns and become horizontal rules under the breakpoint: 672px for two pillars, 768px for three, 896px for four. align sets the heading and the columns from the start or from the middle. Nothing animates. The pillar headings are one level under the section's heading. labels translates the link.
